mapper.sql: sv.id AS skill_version_id, sv.skill_id AS skill_id, s.name AS skill_name, sv.version AS version, sv.artifact_key AS artifact_key, sv.sha256 AS sha256, sv.size_bytes AS size_bytes, s.status AS skill_status, sv.certification AS certification, sv.certify_note AS certify_note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_version sv JOIN skill s ON s.id = sv.skill_id WHERE sv.skill_id = #{skillId} AND sv.version = #{version}

mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{skillId}
